title: Flagged for review: every irregularity found this session
policy: a flag is published with the source that shows it. None of these blocks publishing the site; each one blocks a claim.

rows.what: No officially published price with a known capture time exists in the repository
rows.detail: 6,345 official-source rows have unpublished timing; 5,901 timestamped rows are non-official. Intersection empty.

rows.what: The results feed is missing 9 of the 13 week-10 2026 games
rows.detail: A feed-only build scores 137 games instead of 150; the union fixes it.

rows.what: Club code spelled two ways: 'AZ' in one corpus and 'ARI' in the feed
rows.detail: A naive join drops or duplicates nine 2026 games.

rows.what: 16 of 149 pre-registered 2026 corpus rows cite the week schedule page, not the game centre
rows.detail: The official source is correct but coarser; per-game provenance is weaker on those rows.

rows.what: Houston publishes its depth chart only as an image
rows.detail: No depth-order source is verified for all 32 clubs, so the brief's own gate keeps the backup-deficiency feature closed.

rows.what: Only 16 of 253 Week 11 injury rows carry a game designation
rows.detail: A model feature on designations has one fixture of coverage this week.

rows.what: The 2026 price store's week-11 'close' is the latest posted line, not a close
rows.detail: 78 rows carry the store's own label 'game not played yet - number is the latest POSTED line, not a close'.

rows.what: One job description file in the repo stores a raw capture whose bytes are 371,313 while a peer's summary table says 3,713
rows.detail: A reader comparing documents sees two byte counts for one file; the file's true size is 371,313 and its sha256 matches the peer's hash.
rows.effect: disclosed; the hash is the identity that matters

rows.what: This session could not read any official page live
rows.detail: The sandbox has no HTTPS egress to nfl.com. Every number here is a stored capture or a computation over one.

rows.what: The repository holds no snap counts, no inactive lists and no game books
rows.detail: Three requirements (R10, R11, R29, R43) cannot be met at all; no substitute is used.

rows.what: Two clubs' depth charts still list players who are on the reserve list
rows.detail: TEN lists Peter Skoronski and Tommy Townsend at rank 1 after their 11/14 reserve move.

rows.what: A player's name is rendered two ways across two reads of the same page
rows.detail: 'Dee Alford' and 'De'Alford, Dee' on the Buffalo table; not merged on a guess.

rows.what: No recorded rights decision covers the raw rows republished in this public repository
rows.detail: Requirement R38 asks for a public/private split; none exists.

rows.what: The 2025 validation block and the 2026 holdout come from one publisher
rows.detail: Corroboration between stored captures is not independence from the publisher.
